programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: The 77: A City of Neighborhoods
programme.desc: The energy is palpable in Humboldt Park, home to a thriving Puerto Rican community. The centerpiece of the neighborhood is the Paseo Boricua, a colorful cultural corridor that proudly showcases the history, culture, and cuisines of Puerto Rico. Join us as we meet a few of the area’s inspiring residents and multi-generational businesses.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.sub-title: Road Trip Masters: Grand Haven, MI
programme.desc: Nick & Brian road trip to the great state of Michigan to the lakeside town of Grand Haven. Join them as they head out with the Coast Guard, meet an award winning brewmaster, go behind the scenes of a massive water fountain show, find a blueberry haven, and experience the delectable work of some incredible sandwich artisans!

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.desc: Our first official stop in Alaska: Juneau! Neither of us were ready for how smitten we'd become with the capitol of Alaska. In our first few days in Juneau we explore multiple glaciers, meet and hike with a few locals, try some local food and beer, all while having the most breathtaking camp views we've ever had.

programme.title: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programme.desc: The beautiful, protected waters in southeast Alaska are filled with islands and bays rich with wildlife. The concentration of diversity in this secluded environment is remarkable. Art goes by boat on a voyage of discovery, encountering dramatic calving glaciers and Sitka spruce forests, breaching orcas and migrating humpbacks, eagles and barnacle-eating bears.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave & Kari visit the Dominican Republic and explore the town of Samana, then go to Bacardi Island.

programme.title: Toque 12
programme.desc: In this episode Phil welcomes us to Ku De Ta in Seminyak, Bali where he is head executive chef to prepare a couple of his signature dishes with fellow chef, Ben Cross.

programme.title: It’s How You Get There
programme.desc: Sam, Julian, and Jenn experience a variety of exciting modes of transportation as they journey across the country. They use things such as trucks, cars and motorcycles, and they also experiment with ATVs, boats, jet skis, and air travel. Each episode features their competition with each other, including wagers, witty banter and adrenaline to keep the viewers entertained. They are continuously learning as they try out these new modes to see which one they consider the best. This is "It's How You Get There".

programme.title: Lost And Found
programme.sub-title: Ice Caves and Ice Climbing in Alaska
programme.desc: Still in Juneau Alaska we head out to Mendenhall Glacier or Aak'wtaaksit, to the native Tlingit people which translates to the Glacier Behind the Little Lake. We spend an entire day exploring and ice climbing with some new friends. After getting to know the glacier we head back out for one last adventure into the the ice before boarding the ferry to our next destination.

programme.title: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programme.desc: Torres del Paine National Park in the far southern Andes of Patagonia is remote and challenging. For adventurers it's the "edge" destination. Art's images tell a story of nature at its wildest - of a place where jagged peaks scrape the sky, icebergs catch the light, guanacos watch for pumas and Andean condors rule the skies.
